title: SQLite Sync Guard
user: A developer synchronizing folders between devices who needs an unambiguous warning and a safe export path before live SQLite/WAL files are copied or corrupted.
smallest_useful_product: CLI scans a configured sync root for SQLite DB/WAL/SHM files, detects active locks, explains risk, produces a consistent SQLite backup plus manifest, and writes ignore rules for supported sync clients.
success_measure: On a fixture set of WAL and rollback-journal databases, it detects 100% of unsafe live sets and its exported backup passes sqlite3 integrity_check after transfer.
constraints: Never alter a live database without an explicit command; use SQLite's supported backup mechanisms; document that it prevents unsafe copying rather than enabling concurrent writes.
